description: A mod for Minecraft which adds a village-building mechanic and mobs

mods.name: Questown
mods.description: Questown is a new mod that intends to add a quest-based component to village building.

releases.notes:
> A "grab bag" of fixes, improvements, and changes.

## New Villager Jobs and Rooms
- Added Mineshaft and Miner
- Extendable "cook" jobs
  - Any item added to the `villager_simple_furnace_food_raw` tag will be
    considered by the cook, who will put said items into furnaces.
- Removed "gather with pickaxe" in favour of miner

## Hunger Redux (Experimental)
- Added "starving" visual effect
- Re-enabled hunger by default
  - Can be toggled at runtime via `/qt config toggle_hunger <FLAG_POS>`
- Made dining "jobs" more likely to result in villagers eating something
- Updated "leaver" jobs to allow sensible progress even without food
  - Known Bug: With this restructure, jobs MUST include >0 work-ticks,
    otherwise the job won't transition to "WAITING FOR TIMER" and the
    villagers will not disappear as they should.

## Onboarding Improvements
- Tweaked onboarding quests to feel more organic and possible
- Added "bonus" food that can be claimed to kickstart village
- First villager now always asks for bedroom, job board, and storage
  - To align better with tutorial.
- Added hunter/gatherer root jobs and quests
  - This helps with getting food during early-game
- When spending Blocks of Progress to change a villager's career for the
  first time, Questown will now ALWAYS make that new career "hunter".
  - After the first time, it will be random like always.
- Economy tab now shows ingredients that were needed "deeper" into the job
  - E.g. If the village is missing ingredients for step "4" of a job, that ingredient 
    will be shown on the economics tab.

## Realism
- Villagers now prefer being inside rooms at night - even if there are no beds.
- Villagers now "relax" around town after working for certain amount of time
- Villagers now look at nearby players for a moment when approached
- Villagers now render an off-hand item by default
    - Makes "add food to job site" job look more natural (e.g. gatherers holding tools)

## Gameplay
- Clicking on a villager's status now opens the job definition UI
- Clearer messaging when work seeker stalls due to no job board
- Single-block, wall-less rooms (e.g. mineshaft, fishing station) now
  trigger the "room created" and "room destroyed" messages.

##Fixes
- Sub-blocks (e.g. town gate) no longer self-destruct when you walk away from town
- Fixed bug where status text overrides were not showing up on flag UI
- Economics are now saved/loaded across server restarts
- Job change request now survives server reboot
- Job change now always guarantees a different root than the current job
- When job change was already requested, the villager UI will indicate that
  - Prevents players from wasting Blocks of Progress by requesting twice
- Scheduled "new career" is no longer cancelled via normal job transitions
- Tutorial quest batch 3 now makes sense
  - Was requesting "town gate" because, for batch 3, the town only has two
    villagers: gatherer and hunter (who both use the gate)
- Second (etc.) page of flag "villagers" screen now shows correct tooltips
- Cook now stocks coal if *any* cooked food is requested (not just cod)
- Fixed crash when adding some work requests
- BlockRooms no longer crash server when blocks are missing item defns
- Quest batches now have a limit to how big they can grow to
- No longer crashes when messages are broadcast before flag init is done
- Other random crash fixes

## Technical:
- Added `qt flag <pos> destroy` command which removes flag and villagers
- Updated `qt flag` commands to request position as first argument
- Economics history size is now has a config value
- Lowered some log levels by default (now "debug" level)
  - Added `/qtdev debug` command(s) to upgrade them at runtime
  - Developers can use the INVISIBLE_LOG_LEVEL environment variable to
    set them to 'trace', making the logs less noisy.
- SubBlocks are now harder to use wrong
  - More logic moved to parent
  - Player is prompted to link via town wand if needed

...

releases.notes:
# The Copenhagen Update (Part 1)

(Named as such because I've selected a handful of "fun" features to implement before I move away from Copenhagen)

### New Job: Fisher / Fishing Station    
- Added new "station" block which renders fishing lines when used
- Station block can only be crafted by "crafter" villagers
   - Used "after extract" hook to associate fishing station with town
- Station block can be placed outside of rooms and villagers will still use it for work
   - See "Jobs API", below

### New Job: Fish Cook / Kitchens
- Added a bunch of "kitchen" room recipes
- Added "cook" jobs which can:
   - Add coal to an empty furnace in a kitchen
   - Add coal to a chest in a kitchen
   - Add fish to a furnace with an empty input slot
   - Extract cooked villager food from a furnace
      - Even if the cooking was started by someone else (e.g. a player)
      - Requires a stick "tool" for now, due to technical limitations

### Villagers:
- Improved interaction spot logic (i.e. don't stand on water or air)
- Added more aggressive navigation "unsticking"
- Updated jobs UI to show all job roots if in creative mode

### Quests:
- Fixed bug where declined quest batches ramp up difficulty
- Improved upgrade quest logic
- Made upgrade quests a possible result after declining a batch
- Fixed bug where town could get stuck with only finished quests
- Updated Quests UI to recognize block-rooms

### Leveling:
- Fixed the "infinite BOP" bug
   - Caused by the client-side slot not being emptied

### Jobs API:
- Auto-registration for blocks that double as rooms
- Added "block rooms": single blocks that behave like rooms
   - Welcome mat and town flag always behaved like this
   - Fishing rod now does, too.
- Added "loot" option for job definitions
- Added "after extract" hook for special rules
- Added "has_item_in_slot_initially" to version 2 job definitions
   - This allows jobs to only start if the job block has a specific item 
     in a specific slot (or minecraft:air if the slot must be empty)
- Added "insert_into_slot_0", "insert_into_slot_1" special rules
  - Currently used by fish cook to insert raw food and coal, respectively
- Added "take_from_slot_2" special rule
  - Currently used by fish cook to extract cooked food from furnaces

### Other:
- Added room recipes for storage progression (e.g. small/bin/huge storage, warehouse, etc.)
- Bunch of translations added
